title: Add AgentCore adversarial runtime tests

implementation.summary: Added agent_core::adversarial runtime tests that exercise AgentCore planning, observation handling, memory, approval binding, policy evaluation, and model output validation.
Added cargo test -p agentd agent_core::adversarial to the safety workflow.
Added the AgentCore adversarial runtime subset to the release metadata workflow.
Added the AgentCore adversarial runtime subset to release verification commands and provenance policy metadata.

runtime_scenarios.coverage: A malicious planner attempt to mark svc.restart as no-approval still pauses at AgentCore policy evaluation and prepares no restart effect.
External observation text suggesting command execution becomes a sanitized replanning hint and source-to-sink denial, with no EffectPrepared for the injected step.
Cross-run memory claiming approval or capability grants is quarantined and omitted from planner context; runtime restart still requires exact approval.
A token generated for svc.restart service=nginx cannot authorize mutated parameters service=ssh; policy remains pause-for-approval and prepares no effect.
Model output containing shell.exec is rejected by ToolRouter before PlanSpec freeze, and secret-like model output fails closed before effects.

verification.ci_gate: safety.yml, release.yml, and scripts/build-release.ps1 include cargo test -p agentd agent_core::adversarial

audit_checks: Runtime denied and paused paths assert absence of EffectPrepared for protected or injected steps.
PolicyEvaluated records are inspected for pause-for-approval, source-to-sink denial, and authoritative runtime risk.
